name: uffda-vscode
description: Language support for Uffda (.uff) grammars: diagnostics, highlighting, and an MCP server for AI agent tools.

uffda.lsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Overrides the `uffda` executable used to launch the language server and MCP server, bypassing `PATH` resolution and automatic download entirely. Intended for debugging a local source checkout (for example `deno`). Used verbatim together with `#uffda.lsp.serverArgs#`.

uffda.lsp.serverArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to `#uffda.lsp.serverPath#` when launching the language server, in place of the default `lsp` argument. Only used when `#uffda.lsp.serverPath#` is set. For example, to run from source: `["run", "-A", "./mod.ts", "lsp"]`.

uffda.mcp.serverArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to `#uffda.lsp.serverPath#` when launching the MCP server, in place of the default `mcp` argument. Only used when `#uffda.lsp.serverPath#` is set. For example, to run from source: `["run", "-A", "./mod.ts", "mcp"]`.
